'''Aneil''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He was the childhood friend of Reed and Lucana, as well as a sorcerer who proposed an endless succession of strategies on their journey.

==In-Game Appearance==
As an NPC character, Aneil's first appearance is in Grand Quest - Those Who Lead.
